verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's own docs show the address receives and stores packages (held up to 10 days) and that physical items can be forwarded, including internationally and expedited for per-shipment fees. Nothing documents which carriers are accepted, package consolidation, or in-person pickup. Missing for 10: confirmation that all major carriers (UPS/FedEx/DHL/USPS) are accepted, package consolidation, local pickup option, holding beyond 10 days, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a digital nomad, the address accepts packages from all major carriers and can consolidate or hold them for pickup or forwarding

citations.quote: Physical mail is stored for up to 30 days for letters and 10 days for packages
easily forward physical items wherever you need them
International $5 per shipment plus postage ... Expedited shipment $10 per shipment plus postage
